evidence.description: README names Replication.do as the data preparation, analysis and table program and identifies the manual table steps.
evidence.quote: The “Replication.do” file shows the code to convert and transform raw data, execute statistical or econometric analyses, and generate Tables 1 – 12 in the paper. Earlier versions of Stata were used during the paper’s development, and the current replication is conducted with StataNow 19.5. With the exception of Tables 1 and 2 where some manual calculation is necessary, outputs from the program are .csv or .doc files for all tables (see below for more details regarding the manual calculation required).

evidence.description: MonthlyCRSP is consumed and the code filters share codes and uses permno, ticker, date and return to build quarterly returns.
evidence.quote:
use MonthlyCRSP, clear
rename *, lower
keep if shrcd == 10 | shrcd == 11 
gen yq = yq(year(date),quarter(date))
keep permno ticker date yq ret

evidence.description: DailyReturns is consumed; the code filters share codes and uses permno, date, return and equal-weighted return.
evidence.quote:
use DailyReturns, clear
rename *, lower
keep if shrcd == 10 | shrcd == 11 
duplicates drop
sort permno date
replace ret = 0 if missing(ret)
by permno: gen CARe_m1_1 = (1+ret[_n-1])*(1+ret)*(1+ret[_n+1]) - (1+ewret[_n-1])*(1+ewret)*(1+ewret[_n+1])

evidence.description: Daily CAR construction consumes adjacent observations and explicitly constructs minus-seven-to-plus-seven return windows.
evidence.quote:
forvalues i = 0(1)14 {
	by permno: gen tempret_`i' = 1+ret[_n+`i'-7]
	replace tempret_`i' = 1 if missing(tempret_`i')
	by permno: gen tempewret_`i' = 1+ewret[_n+`i'-7]
	replace tempewret_`i' = 1 if missing(tempewret_`i')
}	
by permno: gen CARe_m1_7 = tempret_6*tempret_7*tempret_8*tempret_9*tempret_10*tempret_11*tempret_12*tempret_13*tempret_14 - ///
						   tempewret_6*tempewret_7*tempewret_8*tempewret_9*tempewret_10*tempewret_11*tempewret_12*tempewret_13*tempewret_14							   
by permno: gen CARe_m7_7 =   tempret_0*tempret_1*tempret_2*tempret_3*tempret_4*tempret_5*tempret_6*tempret_7*tempret_8*tempret_9*tempret_10*tempret_11*tempret_12*tempret_13*tempret_14 - ///
						   tempewret_0*tempewret_1*tempewret_2*tempewret_3*tempewret_4*tempewret_5*tempewret_6*tempewret_7*tempewret_8*tempewret_9*tempewret_10*tempewret_11*tempewret_12*tempewret_13*tempewret_14									   					   
rename date eadate
keep permno eadate CARe_m1_1 CARe_m1_7 CARe_m7_7
save CARLookUp, replace

evidence.description: CompustatQuarterly is consumed; the code drops, renames and derives fields from the specified quarterly fundamentals columns.
evidence.quote:
use CompustatQuarterly, clear 
rename *, lower
rename lpermno permno
drop indfmt consol popsrc datafmt curcdq datacqtr
gen year = year(datadate)
gen month = month(datadate)
gen yq = yq(year(datadate),quarter(datadate))
sort gvkey yq permno
duplicates drop gvkey yq, force
sort gvkey yq
gen capxq = capxy 
gen size = ln(cshoq*prccq)
gen roa = ibq/atq
gen BM = seqq/(prccq*cshoq)
gen lev = ltq/atq
rename fyearq fyear
destring gvkey sic, replace
keep gvkey permno fqtr rdq sic yq size roa BM lev

evidence.description: EarningsSurprises is consumed using gvkey, rdq, repdats, act and sue3 to create event-date, loss and SUE fields.
evidence.quote:
use EarningsSurprises, clear
replace rdq = repdats if missing(rdq)
replace repdats = rdq if missing(repdats)
gen eadate = min(rdq,repdats)
drop if missing(eadate)
gen Loss = (act < 0)
keep gvkey eadate sue3 Loss 
rename sue3 SUE
format %td eadate
destring gvkey, replace
duplicates drop gvkey eadate, force

evidence.description: pub_employee_panel is consumed using member, merchant, wage, month, state and income-class fields to build employee characteristics.
evidence.quote:
use pub_employee_panel, clear
keep unique_mem_id primary_merchant_name wage mofd state income_class
joinby primary_merchant_name using merchant_mapping, unmatched(master)
keep if mofd >= ym(year(listed_date),month(listed_date)) & mofd <= ym(year(delisted_date),month(delisted_date))
rename mofd ym
bys unique_mem_id: egen median_wage = median(wage)
bys unique_mem_id ticker: egen first_ym = min(ym)
bys unique_mem_id ticker: gen tenure = ym - first_ym
sum median_wage, detail
drop if median_wage <= 1500    
drop median_wage
keep unique_mem_id ticker wage ym state income_class tenure first_ym
duplicates drop unique_mem_id ticker ym, force
save EmployeeCharData, replace

evidence.description: HasInvExp is generated from the separate employee stock-transaction input.
evidence.quote:
use MainSamplePrePost, clear
		keep unique_mem_id eadate
		duplicates drop
		rename eadate date
		joinby unique_mem_id date using bank2broker_new_pub_emp, unmatched(both)
		sort unique_mem_id date
		rangestat (sum) sum = bank2broker, interval(date . 0) by(unique_mem_id)
		gen HasInvExp = (sum > 0)
		keep unique_mem_id date HasInvExp
		rename date eadate
		save HasInvExp, replace
restore

evidence.description: The RavenPack import loop iterates over calendar years 2013–2021 and twelve monthly CSV suffixes.
News code consumes relevance, headline, type, country, timestamp, story/entity IDs, reporting dates, and sentiment.
evidence.quote:
keep if relevance >= 90
					joinby rp_entity_id using temp_allfirmfornews, unmatched(none) 
					gen temp = strlower(headline)
					keep if inlist(type, "earnings", "earnings-per-share", "")
					gen flag1 = regexm(temp, "earnings")
					gen flag2 = regexm(temp, "report")
					gen check = flag1 & flag2 & (type == "")
					drop if (type == "") & check == 0
					keep if country_code == "US" 
					keep timestamp_utc rp_story_id rp_entity_id reporting_period reporting_start_date_utc reporting_end_date_utc event_sentiment_score

evidence.description: News consolidation appends only News_2 through News_100 and erases News_1 through News_100.
NewsData_Daily is joined back to the event sample to construct news coverage.
evidence.quote:
use MainSamplePrePost, clear
		keep ticker ym eadate
		duplicates drop
		joinby ticker ym using ncusip_ticker_link, unmatched(none)
		joinby ncusip ym using RP_entity_id_ncusip_link, unmatched(none)
		keep ticker ncusip rp_entity_id eadate
		duplicates drop
		sort ticker eadate
		gen date = eadate
		format %td date
		joinby rp_entity_id date using NewsData_Daily, unmatched(master)
		replace num_articles = 0 if missing(num_articles)
		sort ticker eadate date
		rename num_articles num_articles_0
		duplicates drop ticker eadate, force
		keep ticker eadate ncusip rp_entity_id date num_articles_0
		save NewsCoverageOfEA, replace
use MainSamplePrePostFinal, clear
joinby ticker eadate using NewsCoverageOfEA, unmatched(master)

evidence.quote:
use sd_weeklycons_4q, clear
		rename sd_cons sd_tot_cons_adj2
		replace sd_tot_cons_adj2 = 0 if missing(sd_tot_cons_adj2)
		keep eadate unique_mem_id sd_tot_cons_adj2
		tempfile SDCons

		use MainSamplePrePost, clear
		joinby unique_mem_id eadate using `SDCons', unmatched(none)
		gen HighSD = .

			quietly: sum sd_tot_cons_adj2 if yq == `i', detail

		}
		keep unique_mem_id eadate sd_tot_cons_adj2 HighSD
		duplicates drop
		tempfile SDCons
		save `SDCons', replace

joinby unique_mem_id eadate using `SDCons', unmatched(master)

save MainSamplePrePostFinal, replace

review_notes: The assigned scope is a complete static source closure of Replication.do; all 21 checklist dependencies are reviewed, and all direct table inputs outside that list are included in the input crosswalk and requirements.

The input crosswalk preserves full catalog schemas and exact field case for selected candidates, compares every one of the 20 direct inputs, and includes the exact fields from the existing readable FirmIdentifiers probe. FirmIdentifiers.dta is not cited as a route because the supplied code does not consume it.

All local data reads were bounded to one row through the frozen helper. Positive source rows do not establish historical or population coverage. The RPA boundary probes timed out and are recorded as unverified, not as missing data.

The original environment.json was never read directly. Six original successful software positives use the original registered probe/hash and exact key names; its typed viewer was used only for the fixed safe metadata projection. The five exact add-on/helper names were checked separately through the frozen software/which helper under Stata 18: rangestat, ffind, eststo and _gnvals are available, while asdoc is unavailable. Presence does not establish author-call or StataNow 19.5 compatibility.

Source quotes rely on the v6 byte-first captures, which preserve source line identity and mask only the RavenPack import path. The masked path was not unmasked, quoted or used to infer inactivity; the visible year loop and downstream field consumers were used instead.

Earlier reader self-test failures and the v5 underinclusive screen remain preserved in probes/ but are not used for scientific source evidence; v6 passed the required fictional fixtures and is the sole source view used here.

The logfile was not read, and no author program, SAS invocation, model/statistical/import/compiler trial, data download, package install or test was run. The only runtime checks were five bounded frozen Stata version/which metadata queries. No applied edits to the author program are proposed.

This is a conditional static readiness assessment only. Historical coverage, vendor entitlement, derived-table construction, field aliases, exact source mappings, Stata 18 versus 19.5 compatibility and numerical results remain unresolved until the listed preparation steps are completed.

Seven local raw components (CRSP MSF/MSENAMES/DSF/DSENAMES, Compustat FUNDQ/CCM, and WCIKLINK_GVKEY) have bounded successful native-field metadata support. That does not establish full history, author extract identity, date selection or any derived prepared table; the EWRETD/EWRET mapping, ICLink variant, unselected NCUSIP field and genuine prepared-input gaps remain separate.

Workspace instructions document local cleaned LM 10-X and SEC exhibit source-document roots as conditional candidates for the headquarters header input. No recursive scan, document payload inspection, download or reconstruction was performed; CIK/fiscal-quarter/state fields, cleaning and 1993–2021 coverage remain unknown.
